name: Sensfrx – Fraud Prevention for WooCommerce
author: sensfrx

sections.description:
Running a WooCommerce store comes with fraud risks like fake registrations, suspicious transactions, chargebacks, and compliance issues. Traditional solutions rely on static rules and often fail to stop fraud. Sensfrx uses AI-powered fraud prevention to secure every step of the customer journey and stop fraud effectively.

Why WooCommerce Store Owners Trust Sensfrx:
– Over 2+ million fraudulent attempts blocked annually.
– Reduces false positives, ensuring real customers aren’t blocked.
– Seamless integration with WooCommerce without disrupting workflows.
– Ensures compliance with regulations like OFAC sanctions while securing your business.

Customer Feedback:

“Sensfrx has transformed the way we protect our store. Fraudulent orders and bots have dropped by 90%. It’s like having a fraud prevention team working 24/7.”
— Shohei Tanaka, WooCommerce Store Owner

Top Features

  • Fully AI-driven risk rating with no need for manual intervention.
  • Block fraudulent visitor behavior before checkout.
  • Eliminate Captchas while effectively blocking bots.
  • Identify and stop users behind proxies or risky devices.
  • Flag unusual or repetitive transactions instantly.
  • Block by IP, state, zip code, or email with tailored messages.
  • Automatically block high-risk or sanctioned countries.
  • Adapts to evolving fraud patterns for better protection.

Keynote: Frauds, Attacks, & Security Measures in Digital Commerce

sections.installation:
1. Sign Up for FREE
    Create your account at Sensfrx Signup to access 500 FREE API credits.
  2. Add Your Store as a Property
    Register your WooCommerce store to receive your unique Property ID and Property Secret.
  3. Install the Sensfrx Plugin
    Download and install the Sensfrx plugin via your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Activate and Configure
    Paste your credentials into the plugin settings to enable fraud protection.
  5. Stay Protected
    Sensfrx starts working immediately, blocking suspicious users and keeping your store secure.

For a step-by-step installation guide, watch our video tutorial: How to Install WooCommerce AI-Powered Fraud Prevention Plugin.
sections.faq:
Is Sensfrx free to use?

Yes, Sensfrx provides free access for up to 500 monthly active users. For larger volumes, explore our flexible paid plans that scale with your business.

How do I get my Property ID and Property Secret?

Sign up at Sensfrx Signup, add your WooCommerce store, and generate your unique Property ID and Property Secret from the dashboard.

What data does the plugin send and receive?

Sensfrx processes minimal user data, such as IP addresses, devices, and transaction details, solely for fraud detection purposes. We maintain strict data security standards and are SOC 2 compliant. For more details, visit our Trust and Security Page or read our Privacy Policy.

  • New UI for the plugin with many new features developed

2.0.1

  • Login pages device fingerprinting bug fixed

2.0.2

  • Critical bugs related to account review fixed

2.0.3

  • Activity logs tracking added

2.0.4

  • UI Fixes
  • Dashboard Stats added
  • AppSumo new plans added
  • Activity Tab with export feature

2.0.5

  • UI Fixes
  • Email Customization Feature added

2.0.6

  • Export Activity bug fixed
  • Email Customization Feature bug fixed

2.0.7

  • Activity logs time zone issues are fixed
  • UI bug fixes
  • Add the entries into activity logs when policies are disabled

2.0.8

  • Fixed bug where Order ID was not received during pre-payment attempts.
  • Review logs are now also recorded under the Activity tab.
  • Manual Review implemented for Pre-Payment Attempts.
  • For Pre-Payment Manual Reviews: Users will receive a payment link only after admin approval.
  • Fixed PHP warnings related to user_id variable and severity key access.
  • Added support for Item Type and Shipping method in transaction data.

2.0.9

  • Fixed bug related to some data discrepancies.

2.0.10

  • Post Payment Notifications: Admin approval now triggers an email notification to the user.
  • JavaScript Loader Improvements: Added validation checks for pid and skey. JS files and pixel scripts will load only after these credentials are entered.
  • PHP Warning Handling: Implemented exception handling to suppress and manage PHP warnings gracefully.
  • Activity Tab Updates: Added loader for improved user experience while fetching latest activities. Resolved pagination issues.
  • Core API Improvements: Under-the-hood enhancements made to the Core API, resulting in improved overall functionality.

2.0.11

  • Password reset now only triggers from WordPress, not from WooCommerce – fixed
  • Password reset activity entry was missing in the Activity tab – fixed
  • Bot Fraud check applied for Post comments
  • Fraud Protection settings page implemented

2.0.12

  • Login Failed – Issue resolved; API now triggers only when the username is incorrect.
  • Order Update fraud check event added.
  • Add to Cart fraud check event added.
  • Remove from Cart fraud check event added.

2.0.13

  • PHP 8.2 compatibility bugs fixed
  • Manual review events approve/deny javascript bug fixed

2.0.14

  • Error reporting turned off

2.0.15

  • Code Optimization
  • oAuth Signup Feature & Verify API Integration
  • UI Fixes

2.0.16

  • Fraud Cases Enable/Disable Feature is implemented

2.0.17

  • Shipping Address related bug fixes

2.0.18

  • Quick bug fix in SDK
